case_rule.A: all mechanical gates pass AND GENERATED_EFFECT AND Q1-Q8 pass
case_rule.B: a valid source-conditioned model Action exists (all mechanical gates pass) but NO_GENERATED_EFFECT or any of Q1-Q8 fails (improvement absent, unproven or review incomplete)
case_rule.C: real inference executed but: decoder/projection refusal (RIG_PROJECTION_FAILED), conditioning fidelity M4 fails, any of M1-run, M2, M3, M5, M6, M7, M11 fails, or unusable continuity (any U arm-local wrist or elbow step in 171->172 .. 199->200 > 100 mm)
case_rule.D: declaration/instrument changed or model output preceded the declaration; a negative control does not fail closed (M10); integrity (M9) fails; the matched control Bc != B (M8)
case_rule.DATA_BLOCKED: preflight not OK: RIGHTS_UNRESOLVED / ACCESS_BLOCKED / RESOURCE_BLOCKED / DATA_BLOCKED / REPRESENTATION_BLOCKED; or CONDITIONING_BLOCKED (the official sampler cannot hold the declared context: mask refused before any sample)
case_rule.precedence: DATA_BLOCKED > D > C > B > A; a mechanical PASS, synthetic PASS or a video file alone never yields A

control: Bc = the official PROXY_B tensor saved by the same run, decoded and imported through the identical path (expected == B, M8)
controls: mask freeing spine_01 / right arm / frame 170 / frame 200 / nothing / keeping a support entry
channel spine_01, frames 171/200 (module + real Blender refusals)
export of a non-B source (identity refusal, real Blender)

export_adapter.check: anatomical world matrices unchanged on all 240 frames (measured 9.54e-07, refuse > 1e-5)
export_adapter.helpers: interaction / center_of_mass (zero-weight helper roots) untouched -> pruned/merged by the official exporter
export_adapter.object_rotation: armature-object rotation keys moved onto pelvis (Basis = Rest^-1 R_obj Rest, rotation+location); object set to identity rotation, scale 0.01 kept
export_adapter.pelvis_root: one static unskinned bone 'pelvis' at the thigh-head midpoint, parent of spine_01/thigh_l/thigh_r (keep offset)
export_adapter.why: without the pelvis the official exporter keeps only the heaviest root subtree (legs dropped); without the bake the sampled 'rest' carries the frame-1 source rotation (tilted T-pose). Both were found on input-only roundtrips before declaration.

generated_effect_rule: GENERATED_EFFECT iff max over Action 172..199 of max(|elbow_U - elbow_Bc|, |wrist_U - wrist_Bc|) (world, fresh readback) >= 10 mm; otherwise NO_GENERATED_EFFECT
historical: A, B, C (W129), D and E (W135) unchanged, read-only comparisons

model.card: unimate_uniml3d_f60_v3, graph attention + AdaLN text, 74.1M denoiser parameters, 150k steps, UniML3D d0f19d9

import.builder: unchanged W129 build_variant (refuses any other channel/frame), new opt-in Action from a byte copy of A
import.not_imported: model root/world/torso/right-arm/legs/hand/finger output, and every frame outside 172..199
import.values: decoded U basis quaternions, unit-norm, sign-canonical to A's key

inference.checkpoint_weights: EMA weights as loaded by the official _load_checkpoint
inference.mask: scratch hook replaces the official (B,J,1,1) joint mask by a (B,J,12,T) joint x channel x time mask: generated = strict descendants of upperarm_l at window frames 16..43 (all 12 channels) + their velocity channels at frame 15; the official sampler docstring: 'or any combination as long as the mask broadcasts to (B, J, D, T)'; kept joints are named via --keep_joints (raw names); the hook refuses unless the official joint mask equals the complement of the generated joints
inference.no: no seed/prompt/checkpoint/cfg/step sweep, no training/finetuning, no post-hoc smoothing/IK/threshold change
inference.path: official unimate.inference.sample.main --motion_edit (asset by directory, test case {'S1_PROXY_B-<clip id>': prompt}, --gt_start_frame 0, --num_repetitions 1, --batch_size 1, --only_save_motion)
inference.prompt: An object presses its left arm overhead.
inference.runtime_compat: torch 2.7.1+cu128 instead of the pinned 2.5.1+cu124 (no sm_120 kernels); TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1 restores torch.load's 2.5 default for the hash-verified official checkpoint; HF/transformers offline
inference.sampler: fixed-step Euler replacement ODE, 50 steps, t in [0,1] (official default)

mapping.coordinates: UniMate canonical Y-up, facing +Z, scale to diameter 2 (official); non-root local rotations are frame-independent
mapping.decode: bvh(upperarm_l) = 6D slot of lowerarm_l, bvh(lowerarm_l) = 6D slot of hand_l; L_j = cum_p^-1 new_j cum_p tq_j; Basis_j = tq_j^-1 L_j (tq = cond tpos_local_rotations = BaseRig Rest_rel, verified)
mapping.joints: 50 = 49 anatomical BaseRig bones (same names, BaseRig hierarchy) + pelvis; joint order = the official cond order (BFS)

mechanical_gates.M0: rights/access/resource/identity preflight OK (pinned code, model revision, checkpoint + stats SHA-256, ungated pinned flan-t5-base, licence clauses, sm_120 runtime, every frozen SHA-256)
mechanical_gates.M1: representation: the no-model roundtrip passed in preflight (export adapter world-equal <= 1e-5; 50 joints, labels/side/hierarchy/facing pair; facing cos >= 0.95; uniform scale; clip 61 frames at 30 fps; decode == B keys <= 1e-5 at shift 0 and >= 100x worse at +-1; own == official decode; non-left-arm context drift <= 1e-5; decoded-B Blender build == B <= 1e-5 m) AND in the run the official PROXY_B tensor decodes to B's keys <= 1e-5
mechanical_gates.M10: negative controls (controls stage) all fail closed
mechanical_gates.M11: native-rate video: 240 frames written and decoded at 30.000 fps
mechanical_gates.M2: Action: U and Bc each a separate .blend with exactly 1 separately named Action; 32 CONSTANT F-curves keyed 1..240; scene 30 fps, 1..240
mechanical_gates.M3: footprint: changed stored keys vs A only upperarm_l/lowerarm_l rotation at Action 172..199; every non-left-arm world point and the object matrix bit-equal to A on all 240 integer frames and all 717 subframes; left arm bit-equal outside 172..199; no subframe change outside [172,200)
mechanical_gates.M4: conditioning: exactly one generate_samples call; kept (mask True) entries of the raw sample equal the PROXY_B tensor <= 1e-4 (denormalised); the free set is exactly the declared support (validate_mask)
mechanical_gates.M5: rig validity: upperarm/lowerarm world length range <= 0.1 mm over 171..200 for U; all imported quaternions finite and unit; no decoder refusal
mechanical_gates.M6: hard pin: U composed onto the W126V-accepted .blend keeps every Action 132..140 hand_l residual equal to W126V's and <= 1e-6 m; pin frames bit-equal; composed footprint as M3 relative to W126V
mechanical_gates.M7: reversibility: U with A's interior keys written back (Urev) is world-bit-equal to A on every integer frame and subframe
mechanical_gates.M8: matched no-generator control: Bc (PROXY_B through the identical decode/import path) equals B in world points within 1e-5 m on every frame
mechanical_gates.M9: integrity: every frozen SHA-256 (S1 clip, A, B, C, Cpin, W126V, W126 refs/proposal, W129 and W135 records, W135 D/E) unchanged after the run

observations.source_2d: MMPose COCO-17 detections of the authentic S1 video (W126 observations_predictions.npz): left elbow/wrist detections exist with confidence ~0.4-0.6 on a SELF-OCCLUDED far arm -> recorded as detector HYPOTHESES
observations.unknown: the true 3D motion of the occluded left arm (no ground truth exists); the right arm is unkeyed at rig rest in A/B
observations.used_for: Q5 only (2D comparison after a torso-only affine camera fit); never as a model input

pre_declaration_disclosures: export adapter (pelvis root + object-rotation bake) chosen after input-only roundtrips of B showed the official exporter drops the legs and samples a tilted rest
check_scale tolerance set to 1e-3 after the real (input-only) offsets showed a 1.7e-4 float32 spread on 3-4 cm finger bones
window 156..215 chosen so the footprint has 16 frames of context on both sides; the official stage 4 keeps only the first 200 frames of a clip, so the export is restricted to the window

proxy.conditioning_content: the model sees PROXY_B everywhere except the generated support; B's interior left arm is NOT visible to the model (masked, incl. the 171->172 velocity of the generated joints)
proxy.label: PROXY_B
proxy.what: the frozen W129 B Action (endpoint slerp of A's 171/200 left-arm keys; A everywhere else) over the window, exported by the declared adapter and preprocessed by the official rig_preprocess; UniMate files call it 'gt' -- it is a GT-free animation hypothesis, never measured 3D ground truth and never a video observation

quality_criteria.Q1: boundary continuity: U arm-local (clavicle_l frame) wrist AND elbow entry (171->172) and exit (199->200) steps each <= 2 x B's corresponding step + 10 mm
quality_criteria.Q2: no reversal flicks (consecutive steps both > 20 mm with negative dot) of the arm-local wrist or elbow in steps 171->172 .. 199->200
quality_criteria.Q3: interior smoothness: U arm-local wrist peak step (171->172 .. 199->200) <= 2 x B's peak + 10 mm
quality_criteria.Q4: rig plausibility: no interior frame near-straight (> 175 deg) and no interior frame bending opposite to A's dominant hinge normal (W129 quality)
quality_criteria.Q5: source-2D fidelity: affine camera fitted ONLY on unedited torso joints (both shoulders, both hips; A readback, Action 156..215, valid detections) has RMS <= 20 px, AND U's interior mean 2D left-wrist error to the MMPose detection <= B's (detections on the self-occluded far arm are labelled hypotheses, not observed truth)
quality_criteria.Q6: press intent: U's world wrist net rise (Z at 199 minus Z at 172) >= 0.5 x B's net rise (B's rise > 0)
quality_criteria.Q7: agent still-frame review: U judged more natural AND more faithful to the source overhead press than B, and U not named for a flick, wrong elbow or detour
quality_criteria.Q8: native-rate perceptual review of the 30 fps video performed (this agent cannot perceive playback: declared NOT REVIEWED in advance, so Q8 cannot pass in this run)

review_protocol: UNBLINDED agent review of fixed-time contact sheets (entry 170-175, middle 183-188, exit 196-201, overview) with source crop, A, B, C, D, E, U; still frames only; written to a review JSON before assess. Native-rate playback is NOT perceived by this agent (Q8 NOT REVIEWED). No human/animator review.

rig_preprocess.command: python -m data_process.rig_preprocess run --input S1_PROXY_B.glb --annotate rule --save_clips --keep_intermediate (review stop) ; then --profile general --save_clips --keep_intermediate --annotation <unchanged reviewed file>
rig_preprocess.labels: offline deterministic rule labels; 0 of 50 flagged; reviewed by the agent (annotation + preview) and gated mechanically; no LLM / external API
